info.title: EchoNova Developer API - Streaming
info.description: Raw WebSocket endpoints for live Speech to Text and streaming Text to Speech. Authenticate the upgrade request with Authorization: Bearer ek_... from your server; browsers cannot send this header, so do not call these endpoints from a web page.

sttStream.title: Stream speech to text
sttStream.summary: Send live PCM16 audio and receive a final transcript for each segment.
sttStream.description: Open one socket per live audio source. Send mono PCM16 little-endian audio as binary frames. Send end_segment when the speaker pauses to get that segment's transcript right away; without it the server cuts a segment every 15 seconds. Each transcript is final: there are no interim or partial results. Each segment is charged at the Live Speech to Text rate when its transcript is sent.

Authorization.description: Bearer followed by your API key.

sample_rate.description: Sample rate of the audio you send, in Hz.

language.description: Spoken language. auto (default) detects Arabic or English; ar for Arabic and mixed Arabic/English; en only for wholly English speech.

encoding.description: Audio encoding. Only 16-bit signed little-endian mono PCM is accepted.

x-echonova-limits.name: Frame size
x-echonova-limits.value: 64 KiB per binary frame; about 100 ms of audio per frame is recommended.

x-echonova-limits.name: Segment length
x-echonova-limits.value: 15 seconds; longer speech is cut and transcribed in parts.

x-echonova-limits.name: Session length
x-echonova-limits.value: 25 minutes; the server then ends the session with reason max_duration.

x-echonova-limits.name: Concurrent streams
x-echonova-limits.value: 10 open streams per workspace, STT and TTS together.

x-echonova-limits.name: Connection rate
x-echonova-limits.value: 100 connection attempts per minute per key.

ttsStream.title: Stream text to speech
ttsStream.summary: Send text and receive PCM16 audio as it is generated.
ttsStream.description: Keep one socket open and send a synthesize message for each sentence or reply. The server answers with start, then binary PCM16 frames, then done. Audio is generated a few seconds of speech at a time, so the first audio arrives well before the whole text is spoken. Only one synthesis runs at a time: send cancel, or a new synthesize, to stop the current one (barge-in). Each synthesize is charged per character when it starts. A synthesis that stops after its audio started (cancel, barge-in or a speech service failure) costs only the share of audio sent, at least 1 credit; the rest is refunded.

Authorization.description: Bearer followed by your API key.

x-echonova-limits.name: Syntheses at a time
x-echonova-limits.value: 1 per socket; a new synthesize cancels the current one.

x-echonova-limits.name: Concurrent streams
x-echonova-limits.value: 10 open streams per workspace, STT and TTS together.

x-echonova-limits.name: Connection rate
x-echonova-limits.value: 100 connection attempts per minute per key.

apiKey.name: Authorization
apiKey.description: Authorization: Bearer ek_... on the WebSocket upgrade request.

sttAudio.name: audio
sttAudio.title: Audio frame
sttAudio.summary: Binary frame of mono PCM16 little-endian audio at the sample_rate you connected with. At most 64 KiB.

sttEndSegment.name: end_segment
sttEndSegment.title: End segment
sttEndSegment.summary: Transcribe the audio sent since the last segment now. Send it when the speaker pauses.

sttTerminology.name: terminology
sttTerminology.title: Set terminology
sttTerminology.summary: Your own terms for every later segment; each transcript then carries terminology with the segment corrected to them. Send it at any time; it replaces the terms set before, and null clears them. The frame must fit in 64 KiB. A list that is not valid gets an error with code validation_failed and is ignored; the session continues.

keywords.description: A term string, or {term, variants, blocked, context_words, needs_context}. Terms and variants up to 100 characters; up to 10 variants and 20 blocked phrases or context words. Terms are written exactly as typed.

sttTerminologySet.name: terminology.set
sttTerminologySet.title: Terminology set
sttTerminologySet.summary: Answers a terminology frame. active is false when the terms were cleared.

sttStop.name: stop
sttStop.title: Stop
sttStop.summary: Transcribe any remaining audio, send the last transcripts and session.ended and session.saved, then close.

sttSessionStarted.name: session.started
sttSessionStarted.title: Session started
sttSessionStarted.summary: Sent once after the socket opens. Start sending audio after it arrives.

sessionId.description: Identifies this session in support requests.

sampleRate.description: The sample rate the server expects, in Hz.

maxSessionSeconds.description: Seconds until the server ends the session.

jobId.description: The id this session's job gets once it is saved.

sttTranscript.name: transcript
sttTranscript.title: Transcript
sttTranscript.summary: The final transcript of one segment. Segments can arrive slightly after you send end_segment; match them by segmentId.

text.description: The transcript. Empty when the segment held no speech.

language.description: The detected language, ar or en; auto for a segment with no speech when the stream was opened with auto.

durationSeconds.description: Length of the segment's audio, in seconds.

isFinal.description: Always true: there are no interim results.

terminology.description: This segment corrected to the terms you set. Present only while terms are set.

corrected.description: The segment with your terms applied.

start.description: Where the replaced words start, as a character offset in raw.

end.description: Where the replaced words end, end-exclusive, as a character offset in raw.

nearMisses.description: Close matches that were not applied; send confirmed ones back as variants.

start.description: Where the words start, as a character offset in raw.

end.description: Where the words end, end-exclusive, as a character offset in raw.

sttSessionEnded.name: session.ended
sttSessionEnded.title: Session ended
sttSessionEnded.summary: Sent when the session ends. Usually followed by session.saved, then the server closes the socket.

totalSeconds.description: Seconds of audio transcribed in this session.

sttSessionSaved.name: session.saved
sttSessionSaved.title: Session saved
sttSessionSaved.summary: Sent once after session.ended, before the socket closes: whether the session was kept as a job.

jobId.description: The id of this session's job.

status.description: saved: the job is in GET /v1/speech-to-text/jobs/{jobId}. empty: nothing was transcribed, so nothing is kept. failed: the session could not be kept.

ttsSynthesize.name: synthesize
ttsSynthesize.title: Synthesize
ttsSynthesize.summary: Speak this text. Cancels any synthesis still running on this socket.

requestId.description: Your id for this synthesis, echoed in start, done, cancelled and error. Generated when you leave it out.

text.description: The text to speak, 1 to 500 characters.

voiceId.description: The id of a voice from List available voices. The voice fixes the dialect.

cfg.description: How closely the voice follows the text. Leave it at the default unless you are tuning.

numSteps.description: Diffusion steps. More steps are slower and cleaner.

tashkeel.description: Adds the vowel marks to Arabic text before it is read. Applies to Fusha voices only.

normalize.description: Reads numbers, dates, times, money, units, URLs and e-mails the way a speaker of the voice's dialect says them.

payload.text: أهلاً بك، كيف يمكنني مساعدتك اليوم؟

ttsCancel.name: cancel
ttsCancel.title: Cancel
ttsCancel.summary: Stop the running synthesis. The server answers with cancelled and sends no more audio for it.

ttsStart.name: start
ttsStart.title: Start
ttsStart.summary: Sent before the first audio frame of a synthesis. Use its sampleRate to play the audio.

sampleRate.description: Sample rate of the audio frames, in Hz.

ttsAudio.name: audio
ttsAudio.title: Audio frame
ttsAudio.summary: Binary frame of mono PCM16 little-endian audio at the sampleRate from start. Play frames in the order they arrive.

ttsDone.name: done
ttsDone.title: Done
ttsDone.summary: All audio for the synthesis has been sent.

durationSeconds.description: Length of the audio sent, in seconds.

ttsCancelled.name: cancelled
ttsCancelled.title: Cancelled
ttsCancelled.summary: The synthesis stopped. No more audio follows for this requestId.

creditsConsumed.description: Credits this synthesis finally cost: the share of audio sent, at least 1. Absent when it was cancelled before it was charged.

ping.name: ping
ping.title: Ping
ping.summary: Optional keep-alive. The server answers with pong.

error.name: error
error.title: Error
error.summary: Something went wrong. Fatal errors are followed by a close frame; others leave the socket open.

requestId.description: Text to Speech only: the synthesis that failed.

creditsConsumed.description: Text to Speech only, on upstream_error after audio started: credits the synthesis finally cost, the share of audio sent, at least 1. Absent when nothing was charged.

payload.message: text must be shorter than or equal to 500 characters

x-echonova-handshake-errors.when: The Authorization header is missing or is not Bearer ek_..., no key matches the token, or the key is deleted, disabled, expired or its account is closed.
x-echonova-handshake-errors.fix: Send Authorization: Bearer ek_... with an enabled key from this environment.

x-echonova-handshake-errors.message: This API key does not have access to Speech-to-Text services
x-echonova-handshake-errors.when: Speech to Text stream: the key has Speech to Text on No access.
x-echonova-handshake-errors.fix: Edit the key and set Speech to Text to Access, or use another key.

x-echonova-handshake-errors.message: This API key does not have access to Text-to-Speech services
x-echonova-handshake-errors.when: Text to Speech stream: the key has Text to Speech on No access.
x-echonova-handshake-errors.fix: Edit the key and set Text to Speech to Access, or use another key.

x-echonova-handshake-errors.when: The subscription is in a state other than active or trial.
The workspace that owns the key has no subscription.
x-echonova-handshake-errors.fix: Check the workspace's plan in the portal.

x-echonova-handshake-errors.message: sample_rate must be an integer from 8000 to 48000
x-echonova-handshake-errors.when: Speech to Text stream: sample_rate is missing, not a whole number, or out of range.
x-echonova-handshake-errors.fix: Connect with ?sample_rate= set to your audio's rate.

x-echonova-handshake-errors.message: language must be one of auto, ar, en
x-echonova-handshake-errors.when: Speech to Text stream: language is not auto, ar or en. A missing language means auto.
x-echonova-handshake-errors.fix: Connect with ?language= set to auto, ar or en, or leave it out for auto.

x-echonova-handshake-errors.when: Speech to Text stream: encoding is not an allowed value.
x-echonova-handshake-errors.fix: Leave encoding out, or send pcm_s16le.

x-echonova-handshake-errors.when: The key opened more than 100 connections in 60 seconds.
The workspace already has 10 streams open.
x-echonova-handshake-errors.fix: Close a stream, or reuse one socket for many syntheses.

x-echonova-handshake-errors.when: The key has reached its Credit Limit for this billing cycle.
x-echonova-handshake-errors.fix: Raise or clear the limit on the key, or wait for the next cycle.

x-echonova-handshake-errors.when: Streaming is turned off on this environment.

x-echonova-close-codes.name: Normal
x-echonova-close-codes.when: You closed the socket. On Speech to Text, also after you sent stop; Text to Speech has no stop message.

x-echonova-close-codes.name: Policy violation
x-echonova-close-codes.when: A frame was not valid JSON, was an unknown type, or was larger than 64 KiB. On Text to Speech, also any binary frame.

x-echonova-close-codes.name: Message too big
x-echonova-close-codes.when: A frame was larger than 1 MiB; the socket closes without an error message.

x-echonova-close-codes.name: Server error
x-echonova-close-codes.when: Speech to Text: the speech service failed; reconnect and retry. On Text to Speech a failed synthesis sends error and the socket stays open.

x-echonova-close-codes.name: Insufficient balance
x-echonova-close-codes.when: The workspace ran out of credits mid-session.

x-echonova-close-codes.name: Timeout
x-echonova-close-codes.when: No frame for 120 seconds, or the session reached its maximum length.

x-echonova-close-codes.name: Spending limit
x-echonova-close-codes.when: The key reached its Credit Limit mid-session.
